endorsements.quote: Prospective validation and health-economic assessment are mandatory before clinical implementation.
The model will need to be tested as a new paradigm in clinical practice, comparing the use of the model compared to SoC.
All experts agreed that the use of CDSS in clinical practice needs a good clinical practice (GCP) / good clinical laboratory practice (GCLP) validation.
Such systems should not be used to modify standard treatments outside clinical trials until formal validation is completed.

unlisted_practices: Require accuracy thresholds substantially higher than current clinical models before using AI to justify treatment intensification or de-intensification.
Quantify clinical net benefit, including decision curve analysis, comparative effectiveness, and health-economic impact, before routine clinical use of AI decision support.
Design AI decision-support recommendations to be simple and immediately clear to clinicians and patients, using visual formats such as bar graphs.
Develop strategies to manage clinician acceptance of AI decision support.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/expert consensus paper offering a roadmap and recommendations for the responsible integration and validation of an AI-based CDSS in precision oncology.
